releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.5 - Readable Dashboard Sales Card
releaseNotes:
• 🎨 DASHBOARD SALES CARD FIX: the Activated Voucher Sales (top) card no longer uses invisible bright-green-on-pale text. Light mode now shows a soft mint card with dark green figures; dark mode a deep emerald panel with bright mint text — the Ks amount, title, Top profile and Sell More are now clearly readable in both themes.
• 🔒 v1.10.4 preserved: Total Vouchers summary card, Myanmar/English localization, long-term voucher protection.
